source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: California Department of Health Services, California Children’s 5-A-Day Power Play Campaign

steps.instruction: Add 6 small quartered red potatoes to a pot of boiling water over high heat.
steps.spoken: Add 6 small quartered red potatoes to a pot of boiling water over high heat. Cook the potatoes for about 10 minutes, until they are tender.

steps.instruction: Drain the potatoes well and let them cool.
Place the potatoes in a medium bowl.
Mix 1/2 cup of Italian dressing and 1 1/2 teaspoons of mustard in a small bowl.
Mix in 1 tablespoon of parsley, 1/2 teaspoon of garlic salt and 1/4 teaspoon of pepper.
Pour the mixture over the potatoes and toss well.
Carefully stir in 1/2 cup each of chopped green and red bell pepper.
Carefully stir in 1/2 cup of sliced green onion.
Cover the salad and chill until ready to serve.
